title: Integration, migration, and verification
description:
Integrate all changes, provide migration for existing projects, and verify end-to-end across worktrees.

Code references:
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:480` — heavy init / migration hooks
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:701` — `migrateLegacy()`
- `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3400` — `before_agent_start` heavy init
- `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts:990` — `serve()` startup

Work to do:
1. Add a one-time migration in PlanStore that, on first access to an existing plan, creates `.local/` and moves legacy `resume.json`, `activity.json`, `generated/`, `handoff-archive/` into it.
2. Update `.gitignore` generation to include `.local/` and remove redundant per-file patterns.
3. Update `@agent-plan/server` and `@agent-plan/pi-adapter` to resolve generated/static paths from `.local/`.
4. Update Web UI build/copy scripts if needed.
5. Run full monorepo build and type-check.
6. Test scenario: two clean worktrees from `next`, load planner in both, confirm `git status` shows no `.planner/.local/` files and `manifest.json` is unchanged.
7. Test deterministic shortId: both worktrees produce identical shortIds.
8. Test crash recovery: kill process mid-write, verify `.local/backups/` can restore source file.
9. Test migration: old plan without `.local/` is transparently migrated.

Acceptance criteria:
- `git status` after normal planner use in a worktree shows only source entity changes relevant to the feature being worked on.
- No merge conflicts on `manifest.json`, `generated/`, `resume.json`, `activity.json`, `.bak`, or `handoff-archive/` between feature branches.
- Build/check pass.
- Web UI serves and updates correctly.

tasks.title: Add migration for existing plans
tasks.description:
Provide transparent one-time migration for plans that do not yet have `.planner/.local/`.

Concrete steps:
1. On PlanStore first load, detect absence of `.local/`.
2. Create `.local/` subdirectories.
3. Move existing `resume.json`, `activity.json`, `generated/`, `handoff-archive/` into `.local/`.
4. Bootstrap `.local/timestamp.json` from `manifest.json` `updatedAt`.
5. Leave `.planner/manifest.json` stable.
6. Remove or ignore old root-level transient files after migration.
7. Test on an old plan snapshot.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented as part of P042 commit: migrateLegacyLocalFile helper moves legacy resume.json, activity.json, generated/, handoff-archive/ into .local/ on first access.

2. Run `pnpm -r build`.
3. Run `pnpm check`.
4. Fix any errors introduced by path changes.
5. Verify `build:pi-adapter` pipeline still bundles web UI correctly.

Verified: pnpm check and pnpm -r build are clean on feat/planner-local-transients.

tasks.title: Verify two-worktree scenario
tasks.description:
End-to-end verification that two clean worktrees from the same commit produce no transient git churn.

Concrete steps:
1. Create two temporary worktrees from `next`.
2. Load the planner in both (e.g. via CLI or by running pi-adapter session_start equivalent).
3. Run `git status` in both worktrees.
4. Confirm `.planner/.local/` files are not shown.
5. Confirm `manifest.json` is unchanged.
6. Confirm shortIds generated are identical.
7. Document results in task notes.

---
**Completion summary:**
Verified: two independent worktrees from the same heca plan produce 113 tracked files with 0 diffs and identical manifest.json.
